content: {"phoneNote":"The phone works in the first screen, but the opening-hours timeline becomes a tall stack of seven near-identical brown bars that pushes the products far down.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero and timeline read well, but the three-column product grid stops at three quarters of the width and leaves a dead right column, and the single-link nav under the centred logo looks unfinished.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Replace the hero-duplicate photo on the 'Ekstra deviško oljčno olje' card with a distinct product shot and give 'Pršut in siri' a price line so the three cards match.","Collapse the phone opening hours into a compact day/time list (group Mon–Fri) and stretch the desktop product grid to the full container width or centre it.","Drop the repeated 'Oljka in sol' text under the giant footer wordmark and either add real nav links or remove the lone 'Domov' bar under the desktop logo."],"blockers":["Phone and desktop, products section: the oil bottle photo is the same picture already used as the hero image."]}
